title: TC-TIB-001 — [Happy path] Create new - inline Additional Option, full flow
steps:
Preconditions: Staging teeinblue portal (store: linh-tib-staging)

  1. Go to Assets > Global Options > New global option
  2. Set Type = Additional Option (create screen opens straight into the inline item editor — Create new is the default/only option here, no source toggle shown at creation)
  3. Set Display type = Thumbnail Images
  4. Add 2 items via "Add new" (name + thumbnail image each)
  5. Save
  6. On the Edit page that opens, set one item as Default value, Save again
  7. Attach this Global Option to an artwork layer (customization_type = global_option) and open the storefront personalization form
expectedResult: Global Option saved and listed under Global Options with type Additional Option. Save redirects straight into its Edit page (confirmed: other GO types return to the list instead). Storefront shows the 2 thumbnail items with the chosen default pre-selected.
actualResult:
Environment: staging-portal.teeinblue.com, store linh-tib-staging.myshopify.com (User A). SDK bundle verified fresh (app-v1.js, Last-Modified 2026-10-02 04:03:21 GMT, contains "additional_option_source" string) before testing.

Observed (direct):

  • Assets > Global Options > New Global Option > Type = Additional Option opened a create screen with inline item editor (Display type radios + "Additional Options" item list + Add new). Set Display type = Thumbnail Images, added 2 items "Red" and "Blue", each with a 100x100 PNG thumbnail uploaded.
  • Saved → redirected straight to /global-options/986/edit (Edit page), matching expected "other GO types return to the list instead".
  • Edit page showed General/Settings/Preview sections (not present on create screen). Set Default value = Red, saved again → toast "Global option has been updated successfully."
  • Built a throwaway artwork (#4572 "QA TIB-5467 Additional Option inline test") with one layer, Personalization Settings > "Use an existing global option" > selected GO 986 (id 986, customization_type=global_option). Opened Live preview (real SDK render, not the editor's own reference-only Preview panel): "Additional option" field rendered both Red and Blue thumbnails, with Red pre-selected (red highlight/checkmark) as default.

Note (discrepancy from task notes, not logged as bug): the create screen for Additional Option DOES show the "Create new / Select from category" source toggle (not hidden as the dev comment described) — "Create new" is simply the default-selected option. Clicking "Select from category" on the create screen works and swaps to a category picker. Flagging for awareness; did not affect this case's pass since Create new + Save still worked exactly as expected.

All parts of expected result verified: saved under type Additional Option, save redirected to Edit page, storefront (live SDK) form shows both thumbnail items with default pre-selected.
